basic.name: Cloudlancer Art: North Wind
basic.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Dan Heng's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Cloudlancer Art: Torrent
skill.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Dan Heng's ATK to a single enemy. When DMG dealt by Skill triggers CRIT Hit, there is a 100% base chance to reduce the target's SPD by 12%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

ultimate.name: Ethereal Dream
ultimate.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Dan Heng's ATK to a single target enemy. If the attacked enemy is Slowed, the multiplier for the DMG dealt by Ultimate increases by {{scaling2}}%.

talent.name: Superiority of Reach
talent.description_template: When Dan Heng becomes the target of an ally's ability, his next attack's Wind RES PEN increases by {{scaling1}}%. This effect can be triggered again after 2 turn(s).

technique.name: Splitting Spearhead
technique.description: After Dan Heng uses his Technique, his ATK increases by 40% at the start of the next battle for 3 turn(s).

2.name: Hidden Dragon
2.description: When current HP percentage is 50% or lower, reduces the chance of being attacked by enemies.

4.name: Faster Than Light
4.description: After launching an attack, there is a 50% fixed chance to increase this unit's SPD by 20% for 2 turn(s).

6.name: High Gale
6.description: Basic ATK deals 40% more DMG to Slowed enemies.

eidolons.name: The Higher You Fly, the Harder You Fall
eidolons.description: When the target enemy's current HP percentage is greater than or equal to 50%, CRIT Rate increases by 12%.

eidolons.name: Quell the Venom Octet, Quench the Vice O'Flame
Seen and Unseen
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Roaring Dragon and Soaring Sun
eidolons.description: When Dan Heng uses his Ultimate to defeat an enemy, he will immediately take action again.

eidolons.name: A Drop of Rain Feeds a Torrent
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: The Troubled Soul Lies in Wait
eidolons.description: The Slow state triggered by Skill reduces the enemy's SPD by an extra 8%.
